subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable failed exec retries ignore volatile output and be allowed to trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix, but it deliberately changes when the agent runtime stops repeated failed exec attempts, so maintainers need to accept that availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
options.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions instead of burning resources.

options.title: Defer for broader loop-policy work
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want session-wide or fuzzy loop-detection semantics settled before changing failed-exec hashing.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after the docs follow-up and exact-head validation if maintainers agree stable failed exec retries should stop runaway sessions instead of burning resources.
